en: Black‑and‑white view of a wooden railway station building surrounded by trees. The two‑storey station has dark wooden upper walls, a lighter masonry ground floor, and a tiled, multi‑gabled roof. A sign above the entrance reads "HÖRKEN". Railway tracks and platforms run across the foreground, with overhead electric lines and a pole visible. Printed caption text appears along the lower edge of the image.
